_about: Massey Ferguson tractors sold in South Africa (JBJ Machinery is an MF dealer). Values come from the official MF South Africa / Africa brochures listed in each entry. Keys ending in _note explain how a value was read. Anything marked ESTIMATE is not published by MF and must be measured on JBJ's tractor.
jbj_fleet_note: The three tractors JBJ uses for the project (client, 28 Oct 2026)
row_crop_track_note: Setting, not a spec: 2 x 0.75 m maize rows so the tyres run between rows. A model can override it with track_m.

mf_7615.name: MF 7615
mf_7615.engine: AGCO Power e3 66 CTA, 6.6 L, 6 cylinders
mf_7615.transmission: Dyna-4 (32 gears), Dyna-6 (48 gears) or Dyna-VT (stepless); 40 or 50 km/h. JBJ's unit to confirm
mf_7615.height_roof_note: cab, tractordata.com (3.06 m with AutoGuide antenna)
mf_7615.ground_clearance_note: ESTIMATE: not published in the sources found
mf_7615.steering_angle_note: derived from the published 4,800 mm turning radius (without steering brake) with a 1.5 m track; not published directly
mf_7615.autonomy_readiness: Dyna-4/Dyna-6/Dyna-VT are all electro-hydraulic (clutch-free shuttle), so direction and speed can be driven electrically; electronic hitch

mf_8732.name: MF 8732 Dyna-VT
mf_8732.source: tractordata.com MF 8732 dimensions + Traktorenlexikon MF 8732 (de.wikibooks.org) + OECD tractor test 2015
mf_8732.ground_clearance_note: ESTIMATE: not published in the sources found
mf_8732.track_note: Setting: 3 x 0.75 m rows; 650 mm rear tyres don't fit between rows on a 1.5 m track
mf_8732.steering_angle_note: ASSUMPTION: not published in the sources found. Measure on JBJ's tractor
mf_8732.mass_note: shipping weight (tractordata.com); OECD test: 11,190 kg unballasted
mf_8732.autonomy_readiness: Dyna-VT CVT: speed and direction are fully electronic; ISOBUS. Easiest to drive by wire, but a 320 hp tractor would normally pull a much wider planter than the 6-row used in this sim

mf_5m_145.name: MF 5M.145 Dyna-4
mf_5m_145.source: MF Africa brochure MF_5M-Africa-web.pdf (AGCO South Africa 2024) + masseyferguson.com/en_za MF 5M page
mf_5m_145.transmission: Dyna-4 16x16 semi-powershift with Power Control lever (clutch-free, electro-hydraulic shuttle); cab only
mf_5m_145.wheelbase_note: brochure: 2500-2630 mm for 5M.125-145; upper value used
mf_5m_145.overall_length_note: brochure range 4162-4686 mm; lower value (no front weights) used
mf_5m_145.height_roof_note: brochure range 2780-3175 mm (tyre dependent); lower value used
mf_5m_145.turning_circle_note: brochure: 'external diameter less brakes 5,010 mm'; the MF 5M web page gives 4.65 m as a turning radius for the short wheelbase, so this is treated as the outer radius
mf_5m_145.linkage: Electronic Linkage Control (ELC) with draft sensing, Cat 2/3
mf_5m_145.mass_note: brochure shipping mass 4000-5000 kg (long wheelbase); lower value used
mf_5m_145.factory_options: MF Guide (Trimble AutoGuide SM), ISOBUS Lite, Fieldstar 5, AGCommand telemetry on Deluxe/Dyna-4 packages
mf_5m_145.autonomy_readiness: Best candidate: clutch-free electro-hydraulic shuttle + ELC hitch + factory guidance/ISOBUS options, so speed, direction and hitch can be driven by wiring instead of mechanical actuators
